shortDefinition: An AI-powered search engine that retrieves information from the web and presents it with citations.
fullDefinition: Perplexity is an AI search tool that combines real-time web search with LLM-generated answers, citing sources for every claim. It dramatically reduces hallucination risk on factual questions compared to LLM-only tools. Perplexity has become a widely used research tool for both individuals and professionals who need verified, sourced information quickly.
examples: Asking "What is the current inflation rate?" — Perplexity retrieves and cites real data
Deep Research mode: Perplexity autonomously researches a topic across many sources
